fusions.name: Moving As One
fusions.desc: Stamps down with the herd, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%). On a hit, every ally strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Shouldering Nudge
fusions.desc: Shoulders a target aside, dealing 7 damage, knocking it back 2 tiles and leaving it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Stand Placid
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 12 seconds and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Plough Strength

riders.text: and there is more of you to move
and you mend while you plod on

fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your armour rises by 5%, from silver your maximum health rises by 10, and from gold your health recovers 12% faster.
